title: Every conscious experience is pre-reflectively self-aware

statements.text: Any experience, besides being directed at its object, is tacitly manifest to itself without reflection, judgment or effort. This pre-reflective self-awareness involves a non-objective awareness of the lived body, and a theory of consciousness must account for it as well as for object contents.

sources.quote: is a primitive form of self-awareness believed to belong inherently to any conscious experience
any convincing theory of consciousness must account for this pre-reflective experience of embodied subjectivity
